locale.description: BCP-47 locale selecting the built-in UI-text language (see config.labels). Empty = browser/session default.

editable.description: Allow editing: drag rows to reorder the escalation sequence, add users via the picker, remove rows. Edits are draft-only until Save fires onRosterSave. False = viewer.

allowCreate.description: Show the '+ New roster' flow (Save fires onRosterSave with isNew: true). Requires editable.

allowDelete.description: Show the two-step Delete button (fires onRosterDelete). Requires editable.

labels.description: Per-key overrides for built-in UI text. Unset keys follow config.locale.

noSelection.description: Detail placeholder when nothing is selected.

emptyRoster.description: Hint shown when the roster has no users.

noContact.description: Per-row warning when a user has no contact info.

unknownUser.description: Row badge when a username is not in data.availableUsers.

data.description: The rosters and the user directory. Bind both from the gateway — typically expression bindings with script transforms over system.roster.getRosters() and system.user.getUsers() (see the RosterDemo view for the reference scripts).

rosters.description: Array of rosters. Order of `users` is the alarm escalation sequence. Items stay open — extra fields ride along untouched.

users.description: Ordered usernames — index 0 is the first contact.

availableUsers.description: The user directory the picker draws from and rows resolve names/contact info against. Items stay open.

contactInfo.description: Contact points, e.g. [{contactType: 'email', value: 'a@b.c'}]. Rows warn when empty.

state.description: Two-way runtime state: the component writes user interactions back here, and writing a value drives it.

selectedRoster.description: Name of the selected roster (two-way): clicking the list writes it back, and setting it selects. When empty, the component selects the first roster and writes that back.

output.description: Read-only derived values (the component writes them; do not bind INTO them).

isDirty.description: True while the selected roster's draft differs from the bound data (unsaved edits).

validationErrors.description: Error keys blocking Save ('nameRequired' / 'nameTaken'); empty when the draft is saveable.
